Our nine-strong ladies outfit were in good form, bolstered by a return to racing by Nina Mills, now over her injury but short of fitness, and Jacinta Moore, fresh into the vets' scene and raring to go.

Then there was Jacinta Moore fighting her way up the sandy climb in the twenties. The positions were now more or less established and by the second time up the hill the Woking girl was beyond Gabby's sight but she, in turn, was miles ahead of the rest.
